changes.note: The ledger begins here: every tracked value and file as the site stood when it moved to the Metrale repositories.
The security contact is published at /.well-known/security.txt, and the Solutions page describes the two kinds of buyer.
licence MIT OR Apache-2.0, release notes sign-up, static contributors, receipts, DGX Spark wording
engine: enterprise composition, News and Hardware removed
the engine page in the front page's design; News and Hardware removed
The film and the deploy and fleet clips are re-recorded with metrale.ai on screen, and the NVIDIA Inception badge has its own file for the dark theme.

Pricing says contact us for now: the tiers carry no numbers, the market anchors and the contract table are gone, and the payback model's license is the visitor's own quote, so the front page and the platform page show modeled savings before the license instead of a payback period.
Recipes link to the engine's recipes/; the launcher README link and sameAs name the launcher
The workstation tier is for teams and organizations on local devices, and its support line promises a response SLA instead of next business day; the support FAQ names the tier.

SMB and edge is held back until the SMB motion is worked out: the page is not built, its address redirects to /solutions, which names it as coming soon, and the copy that pitched small teams with a box or two is gone. Neoclouds stays.

SMB and edge stays published, reworded: Metrale runs on hardware the business owns, the button prices a license rather than a box, and the guide never offers to supply a box. The hold from #57 is undone.
The tab icon is the copper M from the v2 kit, on the site and the blog: favicon.svg, favicon.ico and the 16, 32 and 48 px PNGs. The app icons, the logo and the social card are unchanged.

Brand v2: the brand files come from the vendored brand kit, metrale-assets v2.0.0 pinned in assets/brand.pin. The kit's favicons, icons, social card and Manrope replace the first kit's set and Urbanist, its two logo cuts are drawn by the one lockup component, and copper is the one accent, with no cyan. The docs ship the kit's PNG favicons.

Brand v2: the brand files a page links carry the brand version in their names (og-image-v2.png, the manifest icons, fonts/type-v2.css), so no cached copy of the first kit's files is served under them.
Programs card: the NVIDIA Inception line now reads hardware and silicon optimization partner.
Recognition: the NVIDIA Inception receipt names the GB10 bring up and links to the GB10 kernels, as the AMD receipt does.
Programs card: the AMD line now reads hardware and silicon optimization partner.
